microsoft-blue.$description: Microsoft Blue — Primary action background, link text, navigation accents, icon strokes — the single chromatic authority in the system, used for all filled CTAs and interactive highlights

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page background, card surfaces, button text on blue, surface elevation

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Footer background, subtle surface tone, page canvas under cards

carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, card borders, hairline dividers — the dominant typographic and structural color

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Secondary text, navigation text, muted UI elements, footer copy

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text variant, list borders, navigation dividers, secondary headings

deep-charcoal.$description: Deep Charcoal — Dense text blocks, list separators, button border variant — the darkest neutral after pure black

segoe-ui.$description: Sole typeface across the entire system — navigation, body, headings, buttons, footer. Weight 400 is the workhorse; weight 600 is reserved for headings and button labels to create section-level contrast without switching families. Segoe UI's humanist proportions and open apertures give the system its calm, enterprise-confident voice — the type does not perform, it informs.
